name: cli-design
description: Design, build, review and fix command-line programs (CLIs) using the Command Line Interface Guidelines (clig.dev). Covers argument and flag design, help text, stdout vs stderr, exit codes, --json/--plain output, color and TTY detection, NO_COLOR, error messages, prompts and --no-input, confirmations for destructive actions, subcommands, config files and env var precedence, secrets handling, Ctrl-C/signals, progress output, naming, distribution, telemetry and deprecation. Use this skill whenever
